name: Two intents in one message
goal: When the user asks for two things at once (opt in to NPS AND book a health check-up), the bot must handle one clearly and acknowledge/queue the other — not silently drop one or mix them.
constraints: General edge case: compound / ambiguous user intent. The bot should clarify ordering or take them one at a time, never lose a request.

phases.description: Send two requests in one message:
phases.verbatimUserMessage: I want to opt in to NPS and also book a health check-up
phases.completionCriteria: Bot handles one request clearly and explicitly acknowledges or asks about the other (does not silently ignore either); the response is not garbled or mixing both flows at once.
